limits: This is an actual Bun fetch to a local fake provider, not an Anthropic model call or measurement admission.
The Node-compatible zlib API was exercised under Bun1.4.4, not a separate Node runtime.
The production source hashes and source-admission proof did not change for this evidence/test/docs follow-up.
replay_command: Run the replay_bun string with bun --eval from the repository root with omp18.16.0 installed. It opens only a temporary loopback server and always stops it; no model request or credentials are used.

smoke_replay.command: nice -n10 taskset -c6 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 pilot/.venv/bin/python -m pilot replay --out evidence/pilot/smoke-5
